memories: A village of stilt-houses by the marsh. Children laughing. Your name is Iko — and you were the hunter who kept the frogs away.
Mira, your little sister, handing you this staff on the day you became a hunter. 'Come home before the moon,' she said.
The night the cult came. Lanterns burning, frogs everywhere, and Mira carried off into the dark. You ran after them alone.
The temple. A ritual circle, a hundred croaking voices, and the Toad King's hand on your forehead. Then — nothing. He took your past so you could never warn anyone.
Everything. Mira is safe in the village; you hid her before you followed them. And under the marsh, something the Toad King was only the servant of...

1: A / D to move  ·  Space to jump  ·  E to talk to the old man
Hold Space for a higher jump, tap it for a short hop
J: staff sweep. Press again to chain a second sweep
Jump across the platforms. You can't swim, and deep water hurts
Shrines are checkpoints: they save the game and restore health
W + J: LAUNCHER. Knock a frog into the air, press Space to follow it up
In the air: J J J keeps you floating · S + J (or L) DIVES down
The ledge is too high. Push the crate against it and climb
Tap K right before a hit to PARRY: the enemy is stunned and takes extra damage
Dodge (Shift) just as a hit lands for a PERFECT DODGE: time slows down
Slide down a wall and press Space to wall-jump. Climb the shaft!
A locked gate. The key was on top of the cliff
Fighting fills the gold SPIRIT bar. When it's full, press U for the MOON BREAKER
A brute. Light hits don't stagger it. SMASH it, parry it, or dodge its charge
Your memory is up there: the glowing eye
2: Cultists throw daggers. Swing at a dagger to knock it back at them
Climb the platforms. Hold S and press Space to drop down through wood
The gate needs a key — look high on the left side of the climb
Another brute. Stamina is your life in a fight — don't empty it
3: Thorns line the pit. Stay on the platforms
A wall-jump shaft — the key waits above
The gate needs the key from the top of the cliff
Block (K) stops hits from the front, but drains stamina
4: Push the crate to reach the terrace
Jump up through the wooden platform for the first key
The second key is above the shaft
5: The last of the cult stand between you and the throne
Light the shrine. Whatever waits ahead is big

level_1_intro: ...Water. Reeds. A staff in my hand.
Where am I? Who... am I?
There's someone standing over there. Maybe he knows.
level_1_hermit: Hah! The marsh spat you back out. Few walk away from the cult's ritual with their legs, never mind their mind.
I know OF you. Iko, the hunter of the stilt-village. The frogs' worst nightmare. Now look at you, blank as a fresh lily pad.
The frog cult of the Toad King steals memories. They seal them inside frog eyes and hide them across the five lands.
Five lands, five eyes. Take them back and you take yourself back. And every memory gives you back a piece of what you could do.
Your staff remembers even if you don't. Sweep with J. Up and J throws a frog skyward. Chase it, keep it up there.
The frogs here are not stupid. They feint, they dodge, they wait for you to swing. Watch the red flash, but don't trust it blindly.
A block at the last instant turns their blow aside: a PARRY. A roll at the last instant and the world slows for you.
Fight well and your spirit gathers. When it's full, the MOON BREAKER (U) will flatten everything around you.
And the shrines: touch them. They remember where you stood, should the marsh swallow you.
Brekekekex koax koax... go on. I'll find you again further on.
level_1_memory: The eye... it's warm. I can see—
A village on stilts. Children running on the boardwalks. They're calling my name. Iko.
I was a hunter. I protected them. From these frogs.
level_2_intro: The water is higher here. Trees standing in it like they're waiting for something.
level_2_hermit: Ahh, the Drowned Grove. The cult flooded it to keep people out. Frogs don't mind wet feet.
Why do they want my memories, Koax?
Hmm. Not yours alone. Everyone who saw too much. You saw the most of all, I think.
The cliff ahead is tall. Climb the platforms — and if you need to get down, hold Down and jump to drop through the wood.
The gate on the far side is locked. The key? Hidden high, on the left of the climb. The cult are lazy about hiding things.
level_2_memory: A girl. Smaller than me, with a crooked smile. She's giving me this staff.
'Come home before the moon,' she says. Mira. My sister's name is Mira.
level_3_intro: It's dark. Only the fungus glows. Something is croaking in the deep.
level_3_hermit: Down here? You really don't value your skin, hunter. Neither did you before, mind.
The Hollows are the cult's road to their temple. Thorns in the pits, cultists in the shadows.
Watch their blades — they flash red before they swing. Strike first, or roll through them.
Koax... was I alone when they took me?
Find the eye. It will tell you better than an old man can.
level_3_memory: Fire. The village is burning. Frogs in the lantern light, hundreds of them.
They're dragging Mira toward the hollows. I'm running after them. Alone.
I have to remember the rest. I have to know if she's alive.
level_4_intro: Stone steps under the water. A temple, half sunk in the marsh.
level_4_hermit: The Sunken Temple. Once the frogs prayed for rain here. Now they pray to something else.
Two gates, two keys. And brutes — the cult's muscle. Use your heavy smash, let them swing into nothing.
This is where it happened to you, Iko. The ritual. Are you ready to see it?
level_4_memory: A circle of torches. A hundred voices: brekekekex, koax, koax.
The Toad King's hand on my forehead, cold and wet. 'Forget,' he says. 'Forget what sleeps below.'
What sleeps below? What was he so afraid I would tell?
level_5_intro: The moon is red. The whole marsh is croaking in one voice.
level_5_hermit: Here we are. The throne of the cult. The Toad King himself sits at the end of this path.
He is huge, Iko. He slams the ground and calls his frogs to him. Get up on the high ledges when he jumps.
Watch for the red flash. Dodge. Then smash. Again and again.
The last eye is in him. Your last memory. Go and take it back.
level_5_boss: BREKEKEKEX. The little hunter crawls back to me.
I took your past as a mercy, boy. Some things are better not remembered.
Then come and take it. KOAX. KOAX.
level_5_memory: I hid Mira in the old well before I followed them. She's safe. She's been waiting for me.
And the ritual... it wasn't for the Toad King. He was only a servant.
...So now you know. I had hoped you would remember slower.
ending: The Toad King falls, and the croaking across the marsh stops for the first time in years.
Iko remembers everything: his name, his village, his sister waiting by the well.
He walks home through the reeds as the red moon fades to white.
But far beneath the marsh, in water no lantern has ever reached...

1: Press Space again in mid-air to vault off your staff (double jump)
2: Press Shift in mid-air to dash. It cuts through anything you pass
3: Your heavy smash (L) now sends a shockwave racing along the ground
